name: EU Financial Sanctions Files (FSF)
operator: European Commission (Directorate-General for Financial Stability, Financial Services and Capital Markets Union)
tier_rationale: EU institution (A8 trusted: government bodies). 'Providers (dataset downloads, no value sent): OFAC/US Treasury, UN Security Council and the European Commission, all trusted tier.' (P219 cond 2).

reliability.justification: The consolidated list of persons, groups and entities subject to EU financial sanctions, published by the Commission; a local copy is as current as its last download (TTL 3 days).

error_markers.reason: EU FSF: the download was refused (HTTP 403 JSON): the Commission's public token may have changed

fsf_csv.title: EU FSF consolidated financial sanctions list, CSV 1.1 (';' separated, UTF-8 BOM; dataset matched locally)

terms.reviewer: batch p1-G10-1 (data.europa.eu licence field COM_REUSE, Commission Decision 2011/833/EU)

fsf_csv.notes: Quote: the licence label of the dataset on data.europa.eu (id COM_REUSE, http://data.europa.eu/eli/dec/2011/833/oj: reuse allowed with acknowledgement of the source), checked 2026-11-26; council text P219 cond 1 'EU FSF CSV (EU open data, reuse with attribution; the Commission's public token is a config value)'; research C0524 'EU open data (reuse with attribution)'. Dataset sanctions_eu_fsf (25.5 MB; Range ignored; about 23 s), TTL 3 days through the dataset manager (`v3lum data update sanctions`), never downloaded during a scan. Without ?token= the server answers 403 JSON {status, error: Forbidden}. Attribution line in reports (P219 cond 12). Used by sanctions_lists (batch p1-G10-1).

notes: Owned by batch p1-G10-1 (P219 sanctions_lists). Dataset downloads only: no investigated value is ever sent. The public token dG9rZW4tMjAxNw (base64 of 'token-2017') is a constant the Commission publishes for the public file URLs; core.redact masks the token parameter in logs and the MANIFEST.
